mapper.select:
SELECT rm.cmdb_id AS cmdbId, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT rm.sequence_number, ',') AS sequenceNumber, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT rm.it_code_of_user, ',') AS itCodeOfUser, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT iad.application_name, ',') AS appName FROM user_access_review rm LEFT JOIN its_application_data iad ON iad.cmdb_id = rm.cmdb_id WHERE 1=1
AND rm.line_manager ~* '\y(${DelegationBean.line_manager})\y'
AND rm.bpo ~* '\y(${DelegationBean.bpo})\y'
AND (rm.bpo ~* '\y(${DelegationBean.bpo})\y' OR rm.line_manager ~* '\y(${DelegationBean.line_manager})\y')
AND 1=2
GROUP BY rm.cmdb_id;

SELECT rm.delegator AS delegator, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT rm.delegation_cmdb_id, ',') AS delegation_cmdb_id from delegation rm WHERE 1=1 AND rm.delegatee = #{DelegationBean.delegatee} AND CURRENT_DATE >= rm.delegation_start_date AND CURRENT_DATE <= rm.delegation_end_date AND rm.delete = 0 AND rm.delegation_scope = #{DelegationBean.delegationScope} group by rm.delegator;
select rm.cmdb_id from user_access_review rm where 1=1 AND rm.bpo ~* '\y(${DelegationBean.delegator})\y' AND rm.delete_flag = false group by rm.cmdb_id;
